parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols mpls label protocol ldp.command: set protocols mpls label protocol ldp

set protocols mpls traffic-eng administr.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程的管理权重。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng auto-bw.explanation: 启用MPLS流量工程的自动带宽调整。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng reserved-.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng reserved-bandwidth global [parameter1]
set protocols mpls traffic-eng reserved-.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng reserved-bandwidth global 50000
set protocols mpls traffic-eng reserved-.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程的全局预留带宽。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnels t.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnels tunnel-id [parameter1]
set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnels t.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng tunnels tunnel-id 10001

set protocols mpls traffic-eng priority.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程的优先级。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng af-initi-.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程的AF初始掩码。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。
